subject: Small integ tests fixes (#148)
reason: The change touches only testing/integration/run.sh, the script that builds dependencies and launches valkey-search's own integration tests in CI: it stops deleting build directories between runs, switches the valkey-server build from make to cmake/ninja with updated binary paths, adds colored output, and kills stray valkey-server processes on exit. No module source, command handling, indexing, replication or persistence code is touched, so the loaded libsearch.so behaves identically on both builds — there is no runtime behaviour for a fuzzer scenario to reach.
